brief_data.deck: Nebius Group, the Amsterdam-headquartered, Nasdaq-listed AI cloud that Nvidia backed with $2B in March, reported first-quarter revenue of $399M, up 684%, contracted power above 3.5 GW and a backlog past $50B on 13 May 2026, and secured up to 1.2 GW for an owned AI factory in Pennsylvania.

risks.label: VOLATILE EQUITY
risks.detail: Nebius shares have swung by a quarter in a week; marketing budgets get cut when the tape turns.
risks.counter: Take part of the fee in compute capacity, which Nebius has in surplus as sites come online.

risks.label: MICROSOFT ADJACENCY
risks.detail: Nebius' largest customer holds the cloud lane at Mercedes and Alpine; an Audi deal must not read as competing with a customer.
risks.counter: Audi's lane is empty; Nebius sells capacity, not a hyperscaler brand, and Microsoft stays a customer.

gridfit.label: OPEN
gridfit.detail: no rival in this category lane

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Arkady Volozh before the Dutch GP to test a Zandvoort announcement window, confirm the Neuburg simulation workstream with Audi, and size an Official AI Cloud Partner entry against Audi's 2027 roster.

value.text: Elastic GPU clusters for the simulation load at Neuburg (power-unit combustion, energy-recovery and battery models, dyno correlation) and at Hinwil (machine-learning surrogates, race-strategy and driver-in-loop simulation outside the aerodynamic-testing restrictions). Capacity is rented at peaks rather than bought, with EU data residency and Nebius' own storage and orchestration stack.
value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)

value.text: Nebius sells to enterprises, AI labs and hyperscalers; its guests at Zandvoort, Austin and Las Vegas are CIOs and infrastructure investors, the audience Audi's B2B partners want in the suite. A counterparty with more than $50B of contracted backlog and Nvidia on the cap table is a credible three-year partner.
value.label: Commercial lift for the team

value.text: Engineering content from Neuburg on how a power unit is developed in simulation, co-produced with Nebius; a reference customer for Nebius' enterprise sales in German industry; a European AI-infrastructure story told on a European works team.
value.label: Content and ecosystem

value.text: Official AI Cloud Partner designation, sidepod placement, naming of the team's AI compute environment, hospitality at Zandvoort and the US rounds, and driver and engineering access for Nebius' customer events.
value.label: What the team gives back

why_now.text: On 13 May 2026 Nebius reported first-quarter revenue of $399M, up 684% from $50.9M a year earlier, with AI cloud 98% of the total. Contracted power passed 3.5 GW, ahead of the old year-end target, and guidance was raised to more than 4 GW by the end of 2026. The company also secured up to 1.2 GW of power and land for its first owned AI factory in Pennsylvania.
why_now.label: Trigger

why_now.text: Nvidia announced a $2B direct equity investment in Nebius on 11 March 2026. The contracted backlog exceeds $50B, including a Microsoft agreement worth up to $19.4B and a $27B Meta agreement. A company with that order book buys brand to sell the enterprise tier, not to raise money.
why_now.label: Capital behind it

why_now.text: On 24 June Nebius released AI Cloud 3.6 'Aether' with Echo, a natural-language agent for running cloud infrastructure from the console, and opened a Builder Program. The audience Nebius now courts is the enterprise buyer and the CIO, the audience a Formula 1 paddock reaches.
why_now.label: Product cadence

why_now.text: The final Dutch GP at Zandvoort on 23 August 2026 is eight weeks from this brief: a one-time home stage for an Amsterdam company that will not recur. The US GP in Austin (late October) and the Las Vegas GP (November) follow, and teams close 2027 rosters in the fourth quarter.
why_now.label: Calendar window

why_team.text: Audi's 2026 roster carries Revolut as title partner, bp/Castrol in fuel and lubricants, Extreme Networks in networking, NinjaOne in IT management and a set of consumer and lifestyle brands. Hewlett Packard Enterprise, the previous compute-hardware partner, is listed as departed in the last twelve months. No cloud, GPU or AI-compute partner: Official AI Cloud Partner is a clean category on a works team still building its list.
why_team.label: The open lane

why_team.text: Audi has developed its power unit at Neuburg since 2022, the only Formula 1 operational site in Germany, and says virtual simulation carries the programme because the new units could not run on track until 2026. Hinwil builds the car. A GPU cloud is consumed in both places, in combustion and energy-recovery modelling, dyno correlation and machine-learning surrogates, not just displayed on the sidepod.
why_team.label: A team that will use the product

why_team.text: Nebius is headquartered in Amsterdam with owned capacity in Finland, a 310 MW factory announced at Lappeenranta, and sites in Paris, London and Iceland. It positions itself as a European AI cloud with EU data residency, which a German manufacturer's procurement and data teams can accept where a US hyperscaler needs exceptions.
why_team.label: The European story

why_team.text: Zandvoort on 23 August is the last Dutch Grand Prix on the calendar. An Amsterdam company announcing a Formula 1 partnership at its own home race, eight weeks after this brief, is a story the Dutch business press writes itself; a 2027 activation then runs through Austin and Las Vegas where Nebius' US customers sit.
why_team.label: The home race

ruled_out.reason: CoreWeave, Official AI Cloud Computing Partner since May 2025, is a direct rival.
Core Scientific and TWG AI occupy the compute and AI lanes on the inaugural roster.
Oracle is title partner and the cloud incumbent.
Sister team of Oracle Red Bull Racing; Dynatrace and Confluent hold the data-platform lane.

ruled_out.team: Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team · BWT Alpine F1 Team
ruled_out.reason: Microsoft holds the cloud lane at both, and Microsoft is Nebius' largest customer.
Dell Technologies, Google and Groq cover compute, cloud and inference.
HP (title) and IBM cover compute hardware and cloud services.
Open but not chosen: a UK team with a US owner and no European or home-race angle for Nebius.
Open but not chosen: Mphasis and CommScope hold IT services and networking; a US-owned team without the European story.

brief_data.bottom_line: $399M of quarterly revenue up 684%, more than $50B of contracted backlog and $2B from Nvidia give Nebius the capacity and the motive; Audi's compute lane is empty and simulation-hungry, and the last Dutch GP on 23 August is a home stage that will not come again.

brief_data.the_case_p1: Nebius reported on 13 May that first-quarter revenue reached $399M, up 684% from $50.9M a year earlier; contracted power passed 3.5 GW, year-end guidance rose above 4 GW, and up to 1.2 GW was secured for an owned AI factory in Pennsylvania. Behind it sits a backlog above $50B, including a Microsoft agreement worth up to $19.4B and a $27B Meta agreement, plus Nvidia's $2B equity investment of 11 March. On 24 June Nebius shipped AI Cloud 3.6 with Echo, a natural-language console agent: the cadence of a company selling to enterprises, not only labs.
brief_data.the_case_p2: The neocloud archetype is already priced on the grid: CoreWeave is Aston Martin Aramco's Official AI Cloud Computing Partner and Core Scientific sits on Cadillac's inaugural roster, while Oracle is Red Bull's title partner and Microsoft sits at Mercedes and Alpine. Nebius is the European in the group, headquartered in Amsterdam with sites in Finland, France, the UK and Iceland, and its home race, the final Dutch GP at Zandvoort, falls on 23 August.

brief_data.value_content: MODE A - operational. Neuburg's power-unit programme lives on simulation: combustion, energy-recovery and battery models, dyno correlation. Hinwil adds the aerodynamic and race-strategy load allowed outside the testing restrictions. Nebius supplies elastic GPU clusters with EU data residency, on demand, at the peaks. In return: Official AI Cloud Partner status, sidepod placement, Zandvoort and Austin hospitality for Nebius' enterprise buyers.
brief_data.why_team_para: Audi is the newest works team, with the only F1 base in Germany: its power unit has been developed at Neuburg since 2022, where Audi says virtual simulation carries the programme because the new units could not run on track until 2026. Hewlett Packard Enterprise left the roster in the last twelve months and no cloud or GPU partner replaced it; Revolut holds the title, Extreme Networks the network lane. A European AI cloud with Finnish, French and UK sites answers a German manufacturer's data-residency rules.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official AI Cloud Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, the first full seasons of Audi's works programme. Estimated $5-8M a year, part-payable in GPU capacity. Scope: sidepod placement, naming of the team's AI compute environment, Zandvoort and US-race hospitality, engineering content from Neuburg.
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The Q1 print landed on 13 May and the Nvidia stake in March; brand budgets follow such quarters. The last Dutch GP at Zandvoort on 23 August is a one-time home stage for an Amsterdam company, eight weeks out, and teams close 2027 rosters in the fourth quarter.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Volozh founded Yandex and has led Nebius since July 2024; he signs its largest commitments and its quarterly shareholder letters. Path: Marc Boroditsky, Chief Revenue Officer since May 2025; Daniel Bounds, Chief Marketing Officer; Dado Alonso, Chief Financial Officer since June 2025.
brief_data.opening_angle_intro: Lead with Zandvoort and the empty Audi compute lane.
brief_data.opening_angle_quote: “Arkady, Nvidia put $2B behind you and Microsoft and Meta put $46B of contracts; the last Dutch GP is eight weeks away and Audi has no cloud partner. 25 minutes to see how a Zandvoort announcement would work?”
